column1: # FASA nutrient inclusion limits — commercial-practice bounds on DIETARY NUTRIENT levels.
# This layer sits on top of ASNS. ASNS states what the fish *requires*; this file states
# what a feed mill can actually *formulate and process* (e.g. crude fibre is commonly
# held below ~8 % because higher-fibre mashes do not extrude and depress growth).
# Resolution against ASNS
#   - direction already in ASNS for the requested stage -> the TIGHTER value wins
#     (max of minimums
column2: min of maximums); the constraint is reported with

column1: #     source = "asns+limits".
#   - direction absent from ASNS -> a new constraint is emitted (source = "limits").
#   - a spec code named here is NEVER masked by the premix: an explicit bound always binds.
# Columns:
#   spec_code           ASNS specification code (must exist in crosswalk.json). Ratio
#                       specs (DP/DE) are not supported by this layer and are skipped
#                       with a warning.
#   species             blank = all. Exact match ("Nile Tilapia" | "African Catfish").
#   production_system   blank = all. Exact match ("General-LowCost" | "General").
#   stage_weight        blank = all. SUBSTRING match against the ASNS stage label
#                       "Starter" covers "< 5g (Starter)" (same convention as
#                       premix_mask.json stage_overrides).
#   processing_method   blank = all. Exact match ("pelleted" | "extruded").
#   min / max           bound value in the ASNS unit for that spec code (% for proximates
#                       and amino acids
#                       ppb for mycotoxins — the `unit` column of the ASNS CSV is the
#                       authority). Blank = no bound from this layer in that direction.
#                       These are NOT rescaled: they go in and come back in that unit.
#   unit                optional guard: when filled it must equal the crosswalk's ASNS
#                       unit for the code
column2: otherwise loading fails. Catches unit slips.

column1: #   note                free text
# When several rows match a request
column2: the most specific row wins (most non-blank scope

column1: # columns); ties are resolved toward the tighter bound. Each direction resolves
